evidence.detail: load_disjoint_archetypes SQL computes quality_score but no rank; ORDER BY changes the display position with no stable rank number
archetypes2_api passes quality_score through to JSON but no quality_rank field
JSX renders qualityScore (★XX) but has no rank display; sorting/filtering reorders tiles with no absolute rank shown

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/data/archetype.py:load_disjoint_archetypes, add a CTE (before the WHERE filter) that computes RANK() OVER (ORDER BY quality_score DESC) for all archetypes in the season, then LEFT JOIN it back in the main SELECT. Expose `quality_rank` through the API in api.py. In metagamegrid.jsx:renderItem, display the rank as a small badge (e.g. `#{archetype.qualityRank}`) in the tile.
triage.notes: The rank CTE must run over the unfiltered season data (not the WHERE-filtered set) so the rank stays stable regardless of search/sort. The issue's first comment also discusses a commented-out tier system and a visual stripe feature that was cut; these are separate and not part of the rank request.
